why: The button reads `Quality: High` whatever is stored, so a player who chose `low` opens Settings on `High` and one tap takes them to `Medium` -- away from what they wanted, in the direction they were trying to leave. Only an assertion that the three states produce three different TEXTS catches a label pinned to one of them.
